slice: measurement-only attribution of the leg-136 pending_walk attack loss; NO production behavior change

traced_calibration.note: 137 of the 1,427 gates carry per-gate trace timestamps (swing_observation attack_refused/attack_gate_pending_walk); they classify directly against the flight register. The rest are trace-silent (the receipt's counter lift drains the client tap buffer before the trace drain) and are attributed at 30 s bucket level from the flight register plus the receipt's own move_gates release evidence (walk_released_no_progress(<origin>) names the holder class).

routing_decision.fix_shape: both (c): one combat-displacement rule at the runtime pending slot
evidence: 96.0% of the 1,427 gates sit behind NON-COMBAT movement walks (field-route 467, merchant/other 368, movement-step 307, roam 228); only 4.0% (57) are the combat pump's own approach pacing (benign stop-and-swing, resolves at arrival).

Attack limb starvation: 52 traced gates are authored in-range attacks refused at _attack (playing_runtime.py:1625-1627) while a movement walk held the slot; the script-side displace() (scripts.py:1365-1367, called on every engage path at scripts.py:1423-1446) clears only the NEXT roam aim - it never releases the runtime's in-flight _pending walk.

Approach limb starvation: 213/566 (37.6%) of approach authorships were refused await_pending at _move_gate (playing_runtime.py:3575-3577; the farm pump's approach dispatch is playing_runtime.py:2009) - out-of-range engagements never start, so preemption-on-attack alone cannot reach them (no Attack is authored when the mob is out of range).

Field-route pump holds: goal_field_routed re-aims at the 2 s pump cadence (farm_combat.py:12) dispatch through _perform_move directly (playing_runtime.py:1805) - the leg-136 top gate agents are the most field-routed ones (g04m01: 713 field authorships, 475 gates).

Phantom trip loop: after the dealer->field warp the admitted trip intent keeps re-dispatching trip_leg walks that no-progress-release every ~1 s (walk_released_no_progress(trip_leg) x3 per 30 s bucket, g04m01 19:30-20:19; the merchant pending gate is playing_runtime.py:4663) - 229 gates on g04m01 alone sit behind merchant-class holds.
routing_decision.why_not_preempt_only: Preempt-on-attack fixes only the in-range limb (52/137 traced site share); it leaves the 213 blocked approaches (37.6%) starved - those agents author an approach, not an attack, while the mob is out of melee range.
routing_decision.why_not_budget_priority_only: Approach-priority fixes only the out-of-range limb; the in-range authored attacks (mobs already adjacent) never author an approach and keep waiting behind the held walk (g04m01's standing cohorts).
routing_decision.mechanism: When combat authorship arrives (an authored Attack at _attack, or the farm pump's approach MoveTo at _continue_farm_approach/_move_gate) and the pending slot is held by a NON-COMBAT walk (any holder class except the combat limb's own in-flight approach), RELEASE the slot exactly as _await_pending already does on no-progress (playing_runtime.py:5183-5195) and note walk_displaced_for_combat(<origin>) so the leg-137 census can verify.

expected_leg137_signature: pending_walk gates collapse from 1,427 toward the self-paced floor (order 100); attack_deferred_behind_own_approach becomes the dominant origin class.
farm_approach blocked share drops from 213/566 (37.6%) to <10%.
attack funnel: authored ~379 -> executed ~370 (from 299) and swings 245 -> ~330; cooldown overtakes pending_walk as the top gate.
combat-intent churn (farm_target_authored 3,436 -> ~1-2 per engagement) drops; kills rise from 41.
new census counter walk_displaced_for_combat names each displaced hold class; its per-class counts should approximate the leg-136 field_route+roam+other+movement mass.
